name: Kopage
summary: White-label AI website builder for freelancers and agencies that build sites for local clients: start from AI or a template, hosting in European or US datacenters, own domains, plans priced by the number of active websites, plus a free self-hosted PHP version.
best_for: freelancers and small agencies that build simple websites for local clients and want to sell them under their own brand, with hosting included
skip_if: you need one website for yourself, where the Single Website plan or the free self-hosted version costs less; you need deep design or code control; or you want a refund window before you commit
honest_knock: The terms say Kopage generally does not give refunds, and the trial is 7 days. The AI token allowance (10K on Solo, 100K above) comes with no published reset period or top-up price, and self-hosting a client site on Scale or Unlimited costs an extra fee that is not published. Paddle, the merchant of record, handles returns, while the refund clause is written for downloaded licences, so how a refund request on a cloud plan is treated is not spelled out. The self-hosted pricing page still carries an older FAQ (an Agency Plan with 10 sites, $5 a month per extra site and a 14-day trial per site) that does not match the current cloud plans. The Single Website plan covers one static website and is provided by Website•IM.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-16 in a browser on kopage.com/pricing and kopage.com/pricing-self-hosted, from a Netherlands connection, prices shown in euros; local sales tax, GST or VAT may apply) Kopage sells two things. Kopage Studio, the cloud white-label builder for agencies, has four monthly plans priced by the number of active websites: Solo 49 € a month for 5 websites with 10K AI tokens; Pro 149 € for 25 websites with 100K AI tokens and custom branding of the admin area; Scale 349 € for 100 websites, 100K AI tokens and a separate cloud instance; Unlimited 699 € for unlimited websites with the same 100K AI tokens and separate instance. Every plan is white-label and lets you connect your own domains. No yearly prices were shown for these plans. On Scale and Unlimited a client site can also be self-hosted on the client's own server, for additional fees the page does not state, and fair-use limits on disk space and bandwidth may apply. For a single site, a Single Website plan (a service provided by Website•IM) is 9 € a month billed annually or 19 € monthly for 1 static website. The self-hosted PHP version is free with unlimited websites; Basic Website is $50 a year and Business Website $150 a year, each for 1 website with premium support. The pricing page offers a 7-day free trial; the terms say Kopage generally does not give refunds. Re-read on 25 October 2026 with a plain fetch of kopage.com/pricing and kopage.com/pricing-self-hosted: all plans and limits unchanged. The plan cards print the same figure in four currencies, $49, 49 €, 49 CHF and 49 GBP for Solo and likewise for every plan, so the number stays the same whichever currency you are shown. Orders are processed by Paddle.com as merchant of record (terms, section 9).

schema_offer.description: Solo, billed monthly, 5 active websites, 10K AI tokens, white-label, own domains; Pro 149 € for 25 websites and 100K tokens; Scale 349 € for 100 websites; Unlimited 699 €; Single Website 9 € a month billed annually or 19 € monthly; self-hosted free, Basic $50 and Business $150 a year; local tax may apply. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-25.

compare_with.name: Brizy
compare_with.why: Brizy is in our dossiers too and also sells a white-label agency builder with hosting: its White Label plan was $159 a month for 10 sites when we read it on 9 October 2026, against Kopage Pro at 149 € a month for 25 sites with custom admin branding. Brizy adds a WordPress plugin route; Kopage gives more sites per plan and a free self-hosted version.
